task.description:
Validate API-08 (Bearer token auth) for release.

Check all acceptance criteria from docs/requirements/API-08.md:
- Missing Authorization → 401 + WWW-Authenticate
- Unknown/revoked token → 401
- Insufficient role → 403
- Bootstrap token in non-production → PLATFORM_ADMIN
- Bootstrap token in production → fatal startup error
- 4/9 tests pass, 5 skip (requires env/DB), 0 fail, 0 leaks

Write release decision to docs/status/release-API-08-20260523.json.
